key_decisions.decision: Preserves offense against God enacted through neighbor wrong, all four property categories and open conditional syntax.
Keeps lost property, denial and false oath with broad summary, continuing the condition across labels.
Keeps principal plus fifth and direct repayment to owner, with disputed day-of-asham phrase noted rather than forced into one ceremony.
Preserves named priestly recipients, overnight duration, hearth and first continuous-fire requirement.
Keeps both linen garments, body contact and ash removal/location without euphemizing bodily requirement.
Retains named eaters, unleavened state, holy-place requirement and repeated eating at specified courtyard.
Keeps direct divine first person, priestly share and three offering categories under superlative holiness.
Preserves specifically male priestly line, lasting generation scope and holiness-by-contact wording with alternative prerequisite reading noted.
Retains plural Aaron/sons with singular anointing, day and regularity tension, exact tenth-ephah and equal halves.
Preserves griddle, oil, preparation and pieces while noting uncertain rare cooking terms without inventing a precise recipe.
Keeps successor within sons, anointing and whole consumption distinct from priests’ edible grain share.
Keeps contact holiness, accidental blood stain and holy washing location; notes alternate holiness prerequisite interpretation.
Preserves different treatments for porous pottery and bronze without adding a hygienic explanation as source meaning.
Preserves exception for interior-blood offerings and disposal, connecting chapter 4 without making all sin offerings edible.
